findings.description: Non-5s live scrape intervals must be translated and load-tested; do not infer frequency from global defaults.
Unselected or empty monitors remain inventoried but are not automatically activated by migration.
GPU and metrics-disk source refresh still requires live timer/collector verification independently of scrape frequency.
Current node-exporter is a Kubernetes DaemonSet; native fallback collection needs an independent host source, not just a systemd OTel agent.
